rules.title: check --write locally
rules.text: Run biome check --write to format, lint and organize imports in one pass.

rules.title: biome ci in CI
rules.text: Use biome ci in CI. It checks everything without writing files.

rules.title: Reasoned suppressions
rules.text: Suppress with biome-ignore only with a rule name and a reason, and never to hide a real bug.

rules.title: Respect .gitignore
rules.text: Enable VCS integration with useIgnoreFile so Biome skips git-ignored files.

rules.title: Review unsafe fixes
rules.text: Review fixes applied with --unsafe by hand before committing them.

rules.title: Single root config
rules.text: Keep shared settings in the root biome.json and add package configs only where a package must differ.

rules.title: One formatter
rules.text: Do not run Prettier or ESLint on files Biome already owns.
